Between Work & Home ❤️ | A Little Piece of My Day


Bas aaj ki kahani thodi si different thi… ❤️
Din apni speed se chalta raha, kuch responsibilities thi, kuch apne log the, aur beech mein mere liye bhi kuch chhote se moments. ✨

Kabhi life ko plan karne ka time nahi milta, bas jo saamne aata hai usi ke saath keep moving, keep smiling. 🙂
Aur haan… ending toh Smokey ke bina complete ho hi nahi sakti. 🐱❤️

Agar aapko meri real & simple mini-vlog journey achhi lagti hai, toh Like 👍 | Comment 💬 | Subscribe 🔔 zaroor karna.

Milte hain next video mein. ❤️


#MiniVlog #DailyLife #MyDay #RealVlog #LifeUpdate #YouTubeShorts

Priyanka Chopra Jonas RETURNS on The Ranveer Show, the biggest Mega superstar in Bollywood and Hollywood. We had a gorgeous conversation with her just like last time, her warmth is something I absolutely love. In this episode, we spoke about her goals and their manifestation, how she made it big in a new country where nobody knew her, her thoughts on being famous and so much more. Her new brand Anomaly which is a haircare-based lineup launched in India in collaboration with Nykaa, spoke about her entrepreneurial journey, what she wishes to achieve with her Anomaly and more.

Priyanka Chopra is someone who can make you leave your bed and get back to working hard towards your goals. Out of everything she has ever achieved or will achieve in the future, it is her unbelievable zest to work hard that makes her who she is. Mindset and execution are everything.

"Everyone has struggles, I don't like to be a victim" - Priyanka Chopra

Lastly, our humble request to Priyanka and the team is that she comes and visits our studio in our office space, we will be more than honoured. I wish to manifest this today.
Our 12th episode of TRS was with Priyanka Chopra and that was our 1st ever big profile podcast, which changed TRS forever. We wish to pay back her in some way in the future. Always rooting for ya, PCJ.

Link - https://youtu.be/eavpj-z5Y4Q
